description: Correct a food already in the user's diary — its name, quantity, macros, caffeine or fluid — or change an entry's meal label or note. The entry is identified by `id` and `local_date`, and a food by its `item_index`. Only the fields sent change; macros are merged onto the existing values and overwritten in place, with no history kept. An entry cannot be moved to another day. All calorie and macro values, including carbohydrates, are estimates from USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, the user's own entry or an AI assistant's estimate — approximate, not lab-measured or specific to a package or batch, and not suitable for insulin dosing (including carb counting for a meal bolus), blood-glucose prediction or any other medical decision.

id.description: The entry id, as returned when reading a day.

item_index.description: Which food in the entry's items[] to edit (0-based). Required when changing a food's name/quantity/macros/caffeine/fluid; omit for an entry-level change (meal/note).

local_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD diary date of the entry.

macros.description: Corrected macros — only the components you send are changed.

meal.description: Move the entry to a different meal label.

quantity.description: Portion as stated, e.g. '2' or '1 cup'.

name: update_meal
